_comment: The third-party sources vendored into this repository, and the upstream
commit each was taken from. Inspect drift with tools/fetch-vendor.sh.
Vendored rather than depended on. `lib/wasm/bin/` started as Milky2018/wasm_core
0.5.0 and was then changed in ways a published dependency cannot be: its flat
ValueType was replaced by this project's Idx-generic wasm_types spine, its
silent 'emit 0x00 for anything unhandled' fallbacks were removed, and the
custom sections wax needs were added. See lib/wasm/bin/VENDORED.md for the full
This is therefore a FORK, and the script does not restore files -- restoring
them would throw the fork away. It reports what changed upstream since the
pin, so an upstream fix can be reviewed and applied deliberately.
sha256 is over the upstream file as fetched, NOT over our copy. It is what
makes 'upstream has not moved' a checkable claim rather than an assumption.
